heading: PROPITIATORY PRAYERS FOR THE FAST OF GEDALIAH.
body: Pardon us, our Father! for in the greatness of our folly we have gone astray. Forgive us, O our King! for our iniquities are numerous.
rubrics: Say from “Happy are they,” page 2, till “for it is great,” page 7, after which say the following—
method: Image-only reading from overlapping native-width bands, frozen before opening the same-service existing English readings/XML/OCR in this run. Same-model second pass with prior exposure to earlier encoding and rendered excerpts; not independent-person proofreading. Whitespace and physical line wrapping normalized; typographic detail adjudicated separately.
limitations: Lower Gedaliah portion only. Incidentally visible during Erev boundary review. Prior service above excluded.
